page.overview:
Who is Clashsuit?

A female individual nicknamed "Clashsuit" by the human child Bia Rovyno worked as a shuttle pilot in the Worim system during the Imperial Era. Clashsuit had gray-yellow skin and short yellow hair, which clashed with her orange and pink jumpsuit, earning her the nickname from Rovyno.

Starting between 2 BBY and 2 ABY, Clashsuit's employers contracted her to run passengers between a docking station and the 67 mining encampments throughout the system. Between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, when Rovyno came to the docking station, hoping to go to Worim's surface, Clashsuit shuttled the girl in Rovyno's starship the Someday Ship through Worim's permanent deadly storm and into the mining tunnel complex of Voor Riz-Ehp. On the surface, Clashsuit warned the child that whatever was chasing her would inevitably find her before stealing the starship of Foroz, an individual who owed her credits.
